title: objectstack verify --json writes hundreds of INFO log lines to stdout ahead of the JSON payload, so verify --json > report.json is not parseable
body:
QA-source: #21318 · cli.verify-verdict-exit-mapping · clause 0 (step 0)

## Reproduction (`@objectstack/cli@17.6.0`, any scaffolded app)

```
npx objectstack verify --json > report.json; echo $?     # 0
node -e "require('./report.json')"
# SyntaxError: report.json: Unexpected non-whitespace character after JSON at position 4
```

`report.json` holds 365 lines: lines 1–329 are kernel log lines (`2026-10-02T04:13:35.431Z INFO Loading plugin: com.objectstack.engine.objectql`, `… Plugin registered …`, `HTTP server started successfully`, `Graceful shutdown complete`, …) and the JSON document (`{ app, config, multiTenant, crud, hardFailures }`) starts at line 330.

## Expected

Under `--json`, stdout carries exactly one JSON document; logs go to stderr (or are silenced). This is what `cli.verify-verdict-exit-mapping` step 0 does (`objectstack verify --json > report.json`), what CI and agents consuming the report do, and what other `--json` commands were brought to (cf. the `os login --json` two-documents fix).
